_comment: Display name -> score-file slug, for the rows of the paper's main results
table (\label{tab:results_main} in access.tex).
This is the ONLY record of which score file produced which printed row.
The two cannot be derived from each other: slugs are s3prl upstream names
(vq_apc, wavlm_large), display names are what the table prints (VQ-APC,
WavLM Large), and no rule maps between them.
It is a SUPERSET of the printed roster on purpose. FBANK and Mockingjay
are listed here but the paper does not print them, and nothing in this
file distinguishes them -- which is exactly why the roster itself is the
explicit PAPER_TABLE_ROWS list in scoring/models.py, reconciled against
access.tex by tests/test_paper_models.py::test_m1. Do not try to derive
the roster from this file.
Extracted from tests/baseline_main_results_table.json, which was the
fixture of a regression gate retired in P15. That file also carried
per-model EERs measured on the legacy score tree; those are stale, are
superseded by reference/, and were dropped.
NOTE: the source file was never committed -- .gitignore's `*.json` rule
caught it, so no clone of this repo ever had it and paper_models() raised
FileNotFoundError for everyone but the author. That is why this file
carries an explicit re-include in .gitignore.
